name: Rask AI
summary: Video translation and dubbing into 100+ languages.
description: Rask AI translates and dubs videos with a cloned voice close to the original, including lip sync. It also generates subtitles and short clips to localize content internationally.

howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow—generation, scan, or deploy—using a template or sample input.

howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.
